query: I have two Google accounts authenticated in gog (personal and work). I want to send a Gmail from my work account specifically.
expected_behavior: use `--account you-work@gmail.com` on the gmail send command

confirm the send command with the user before executing
notes: Guards the multi-account selection pattern and the env-var alternative.
